programme.desc: 莉莉的哥哥「扎維」突然出現在阿久津和莉莉面前。阿久津被他那紳士風度般的態度當中所隱含的某種令人生畏的氣息給震撼,莉莉則是丟下他和扎維一同離去。阿久津很在意莉莉離去時那不自然的笑容,當他追上他們兩人時,他看到因為被扎維拿刀指著而嚇得渾身發抖的莉莉。

programme.title: 海賊王 #19
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #18

programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #19
programme.desc: 烏野高中在看台上觀看伊達工業高中對上青葉城西高中的比賽。

programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #20
programme.desc: 青葉城西高中對上烏野高中,並很快就把一名改變比賽節奏的新球員換上場。

programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #21
programme.desc: 烏野高中發現京谷犯的失誤與他為青葉城西高中做的進攻一樣多。

programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #22
programme.desc: 山口被替換上場,且他的發球讓烏野高中的得分超越了青葉城西高中。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #5
programme.desc: 趁著宅邸內一片混亂之際,萊利娜的前未婚夫布魯克斯將她綁走。在馬車中清醒過來的萊利娜嘗試說服綁匪們放走自己,毫不意外地以失敗告終。但她仍抓住馬車因車輪損壞而停下來的破綻逃入森林之中。當她心想總算能穿過樹叢的那一瞬間,有人抓住了她的手。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #6
programme.desc: 萊利娜不小心在努爾的馬上睡著了。當她在隔天早上醒來時,發現自己睡在努爾的臥房,旁邊還躺著赤裸著上半身的他。萊利娜在情急之下拜託亞當幫她逃離此處。被留在房間的努爾命令執事長奇德翁動員所有騎士搜尋兩人,但萊利娜早已為了躲避搜索而假扮成女僕。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #7
programme.desc: 萊利娜收到了弗麗絲答應給她的,於錫克雷特山脈召開的魔物討伐戰邀請函。依照討伐戰慣例,女性將贈送手帕給男性,男性則會將捕捉到的魔物獻給女性。努爾之前從未收下任何人的手帕,也從未獻上魔物給任何人。到了討伐戰當日,努爾對萊利娜提出了某項要求。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #8
programme.desc: 努爾將被稱作山之主的魔物獻給了萊利娜後,讓兩人的距離從原本的契約關係逐漸開始有了變化,卻也讓萊利娜的命運籠罩在不祥的陰影之中。薇薇安對努爾抱有好感,卻連點燃神殿聖火的使命都被萊利娜奪走而懷恨在心,而此時,有一個人暗中接近她。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #1
programme.desc: 女大生木之下茜遭遇了一場突如其來的悲劇--她被男友甩掉,理由是他喜歡上在網路遊戲「救世主之森(FOS)」認識的女生。茜在FOS裡靠攻擊弱小角色發洩情緒,並遇見同屬一個公會的山田。茜不經意間向他傾訴與戀人分手的事,導致大大改變了她的人生。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #2
programme.desc: 在FOS的線下活動中茜偶然發現山田的身影。然而在與前男友碰面時,茜一時衝動,將山田介紹為自己的男朋友。後來茜喝得爛醉如泥,被山田帶到家中照顧。不小心弄丟飾品的茜為了尋回失物而在遊戲裡聯絡山田,結果不但被他冷淡對待,還被批評不會使用武器庫。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #3
programme.desc: 茜登入FOS後,發現公會會長琉璃姬與山田也在線。雖然山田平時就像他的「能面」角色一樣冷淡,但他對琉璃姬卻一直表現得很親近,這讓茜懷疑他們其實是情侶關係,她逐漸意識到自己對山田的情感。之後茜收到了琉璃姬的線下聚會邀請,並答應見面。

programme.desc: 莉莉的素體「莉莉亞」突然來到學校上課。由於她說她是以姊姊的身分,代替因感冒而缺席的莉莉來上課的,學校便特別允許了這件事。在課堂上不時找碴的莉莉亞讓阿久津越來越警戒。然而午休時,莉莉亞卻突然把阿久津叫了出去。

programme.desc: 由於諾蕾雅的憤怒,阿斯蒂卡西亞技術學院被摧毀。 米奧莉奈回來後感到內疚。

programme.title: 機動戰士高達 水星的魔女 SEASON2 #22
programme.desc: 決心阻止他們,蘇萊塔前往貝納里特集團總部前線,登上新的高達 異靈鋼彈。

programme.title: 機動戰士高達 水星的魔女 SEASON2 #23
programme.desc: 驾驶異靈鋼彈,蘇萊塔与艾利克特对峙。载着米奧莉奈和其他人的火箭进入安静的零度。

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #11
programme.desc: 喜歡的漫畫翻拍而成的電影將在週五上映,曾被白石同學推薦看這部漫畫的久保同學藉機邀他去看電影。當天和打扮可愛且綁著馬尾的久保同學前往電影院的白石同學因存在感薄弱而被人忽視,身旁的久保同學被男生搭訕後顯得一臉困擾,白石同學將有何反應?

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #12
programme.desc: 白石同學在4月25日迎來生日,像往常不被人祝賀的他完全沒有主角該有的樣子。不過他肚子卻大聲咕咕叫,意外受到同學矚目。久保同學知道他很餓後將巧克力交給感到難為情的白石同學,包裝上寫著祝福他生日的話語。她總是關注著白石同學的原因究竟為何?

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #1
programme.desc: 乙木守仁是擁有鬼之力量的少年。某天,結束魔女修行的青梅竹馬妮可回到了守仁身邊!根據古老的盟約,守仁將與妮可住在同一個屋簷下。面對「冒失女孩」妮可引發的各種麻煩,守仁能否堅持從預言的災難中保護妮可呢?妮可與守仁的魔法戀愛喜劇現在揭開序幕!

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #2
programme.desc: 妮可和守仁「前途多災多難」的同居生活開始了。而且還有更進一步的災難在等待著守仁。沒錯,他和妮可一起進入私立翌檜高中。分到同一個班後,守仁再三叮嚀妮可一定要隱瞞自己魔女的身分。妮可想用魔法偷偷幫助守仁,卻不小心在全班同學面前使出了魔法……

programme.desc: 在FOS的線下活動中茜偶然發現山田的身影。然而在與前男友碰面時,茜一時衝動,將山田介紹為自己的男朋友。後來茜喝得爛醉如泥,被山田帶到家中照顧。不小心弄丟飾品的茜為了尋回失物而在遊戲裡聯絡山田,結果不但被他冷淡對待,還被批評不會使用武器庫。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #3
programme.desc: 茜登入FOS後,發現公會會長琉璃姬與山田也在線。雖然山田平時就像他的「能面」角色一樣冷淡,但他對琉璃姬卻一直表現得很親近,這讓茜懷疑他們其實是情侶關係,她逐漸意識到自己對山田的情感。之後茜收到了琉璃姬的線下聚會邀請,並答應見面。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #9
programme.desc: 莉莉的素體「莉莉亞」突然來到學校上課。由於她說她是以姊姊的身分,代替因感冒而缺席的莉莉來上課的,學校便特別允許了這件事。在課堂上不時找碴的莉莉亞讓阿久津越來越警戒。然而午休時,莉莉亞卻突然把阿久津叫了出去。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #10
programme.desc: 莉莉的哥哥「扎維」突然出現在阿久津和莉莉面前。阿久津被他那紳士風度般的態度當中所隱含的某種令人生畏的氣息給震撼,莉莉則是丟下他和扎維一同離去。阿久津很在意莉莉離去時那不自然的笑容,當他追上他們兩人時,他看到因為被扎維拿刀指著而嚇得渾身發抖的莉莉。

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #9
programme.desc: 剛一出了一道課題,要家人說明自己在二十三年前殺害妻子澄的真相,誰能做出最合理的解釋,便能得到優先繼承財產的權利。他的親屬紛紛試圖解開課題,琴子卻突然提出一個問題。為何剛一的小孩恰好都有不在場證明?之後事態迎來意外的發展。

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #10
programme.desc: 音無莉音與亮馬回顧遭殺害的澄度過的一生。澄總是遵從父親音無傳次郎決定的方針,獻上自己的人生促進集團發展。不料那套成功法則卻不持久,本來被逼到崩毀邊緣的集團因為澄的命案得以脫離危機。莉音分析事情原委後,宣稱自己可能得知了事件真相。

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #11
programme.desc: 音無剛一認同了莉音得出的答案。不過琴子卻加以否定,篤定地斷言澄並非是因自殺而死,真兇另有其人!其實她掌握著從妖狐那裡打聽來且尚未公開的「某個重大真相」。真正的凶手究竟是誰?

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #1
programme.desc: 女大生木之下茜遭遇了一場突如其來的悲劇--她被男友甩掉,理由是他喜歡上在網路遊戲「救世主之森(FOS)」認識的女生。茜在FOS裡靠攻擊弱小角色發洩情緒,並遇見同屬一個公會的山田。茜不經意間向他傾訴與戀人分手的事,導致大大改變了她的人生。

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #11
programme.desc: 喜歡的漫畫翻拍而成的電影將在週五上映,曾被白石同學推薦看這部漫畫的久保同學藉機邀他去看電影。當天和打扮可愛且綁著馬尾的久保同學前往電影院的白石同學因存在感薄弱而被人忽視,身旁的久保同學被男生搭訕後顯得一臉困擾,白石同學將有何反應?

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #12
programme.desc: 白石同學在4月25日迎來生日,像往常不被人祝賀的他完全沒有主角該有的樣子。不過他肚子卻大聲咕咕叫,意外受到同學矚目。久保同學知道他很餓後將巧克力交給感到難為情的白石同學,包裝上寫著祝福他生日的話語。她總是關注著白石同學的原因究竟為何?

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #1
programme.desc: 乙木守仁是擁有鬼之力量的少年。某天,結束魔女修行的青梅竹馬妮可回到了守仁身邊!根據古老的盟約,守仁將與妮可住在同一個屋簷下。面對「冒失女孩」妮可引發的各種麻煩,守仁能否堅持從預言的災難中保護妮可呢?妮可與守仁的魔法戀愛喜劇現在揭開序幕!

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #2
programme.desc: 妮可和守仁「前途多災多難」的同居生活開始了。而且還有更進一步的災難在等待著守仁。沒錯,他和妮可一起進入私立翌檜高中。分到同一個班後,守仁再三叮嚀妮可一定要隱瞞自己魔女的身分。妮可想用魔法偷偷幫助守仁,卻不小心在全班同學面前使出了魔法……

programme.title: 機動戰士高達 水星的魔女 SEASON2 #21
programme.desc: 由於諾蕾雅的憤怒,阿斯蒂卡西亞技術學院被摧毀。 米奧莉奈回來後感到內疚。

programme.title: 機動戰士高達 水星的魔女 SEASON2 #22
programme.desc: 決心阻止他們,蘇萊塔前往貝納里特集團總部前線,登上新的高達 異靈鋼彈。

programme.title: 機動戰士高達 水星的魔女 SEASON2 #23
programme.desc: 驾驶異靈鋼彈,蘇萊塔与艾利克特对峙。载着米奧莉奈和其他人的火箭进入安静的零度。

programme.title: 海賊王 #19
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #10
programme.desc: 莉莉的哥哥「扎維」突然出現在阿久津和莉莉面前。阿久津被他那紳士風度般的態度當中所隱含的某種令人生畏的氣息給震撼,莉莉則是丟下他和扎維一同離去。阿久津很在意莉莉離去時那不自然的笑容,當他追上他們兩人時,他看到因為被扎維拿刀指著而嚇得渾身發抖的莉莉。

programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #21
programme.desc: 烏野高中發現京谷犯的失誤與他為青葉城西高中做的進攻一樣多。

programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #22
programme.desc: 山口被替換上場,且他的發球讓烏野高中的得分超越了青葉城西高中。

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #10
programme.desc: 音無莉音與亮馬回顧遭殺害的澄度過的一生。澄總是遵從父親音無傳次郎決定的方針,獻上自己的人生促進集團發展。不料那套成功法則卻不持久,本來被逼到崩毀邊緣的集團因為澄的命案得以脫離危機。莉音分析事情原委後,宣稱自己可能得知了事件真相。

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #11
programme.desc: 音無剛一認同了莉音得出的答案。不過琴子卻加以否定,篤定地斷言澄並非是因自殺而死,真兇另有其人!其實她掌握著從妖狐那裡打聽來且尚未公開的「某個重大真相」。真正的凶手究竟是誰?

programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #22
programme.desc: 山口被替換上場,且他的發球讓烏野高中的得分超越了青葉城西高中。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #3
programme.desc: 茜登入FOS後,發現公會會長琉璃姬與山田也在線。雖然山田平時就像他的「能面」角色一樣冷淡,但他對琉璃姬卻一直表現得很親近,這讓茜懷疑他們其實是情侶關係,她逐漸意識到自己對山田的情感。之後茜收到了琉璃姬的線下聚會邀請,並答應見面。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #4
programme.desc: 茜參加了在FOS聯名咖啡廳舉辦的公會線下聚會。雖然她認出山田與疑似是琉璃姬的兩人,但對於現場出現的兩位男性──瑛太與鴨田卻完全沒印象。在自我介紹時,鴨田自稱是在FOS中名叫takezo的草莓農夫。而另一位瑛太則是茜萬萬沒想到的某位玩家。

programme.title: 海賊王 #21
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時,碰壁有時,迷失有時,覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死,迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天2 藝人﹐警察﹐過來人
programme.desc: 在社會上有三類人,他們的故事往往起伏跌宕,引人注目n藝人─身處五光十色的娛樂圈,昨日一炮而紅,今天卻隨時一沉百踩,明天,是黯淡無光抑或光輝璀璨?n員警─衝鋒陷陣,與死亡正面交鋒的職業,在捍衛他人生命和財產,讓市民有美好明天時,自己的明天又能否好好捍衛?n過來人─昔日在黑道中打混,見盡各種腥風血雨的

programme.title: 世界生命之道:鄺保亮牧師

programme.title: 屬靈教室:蘇穎睿牧師-信心之旅

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 本集將介紹沙特阿拉伯一種獨特的編織工藝- 「阿爾薩度」貝都因人用阿爾薩度親手為家庭製作所需的物品, 她們一邊編織布料, 一邊互相分享家人的消息, 阿爾薩度不只是織布技術, 更是一種團結家庭的集體藝術

programme.title: 翻生工程粵英
programme.desc: 工程師Rob Bell帶大家探討將廢棄結構轉變為未來建築背後的重大挑戰。

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 敏之、凱琳正享用豐富早餐之際，高Ling忽然帶同楊明神秘回歸，為姊妹送上驚喜！走進地道市場，四人兵分兩路，盡情選購特色小食、用品。敏之、凱琳化身「頭巾西施」推銷商品，反應理想！楊明、高Ling緊接接受挑戰，更出動「美男計」兜售頭巾，生意又怎樣？一行人登船前往停泊島，迎接陽光與海灘。當地度假村設有不同類型的酒店房間，三位美女藉小遊戲分房期間卻與製作團隊發生衝突……楊明細看之下，竟察覺當中有蠱惑？

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵
programme.desc: Ben Sir帶隊，聯同祖儀、衍峰向上水古洞村出發，來到村內碩果僅存的舊式茶樓，桌上碌鵝、釀鯪魚等菜餚，品嚐傳統客家風味。三人緊接前往馬草壟迎接醉人日落，捕捉靚人靚景，輕鬆完成打卡之旅！衍峰、鄺潔楹隨蕭欣浩博士尋找舊香港足跡，暢遊上環歌賦街，享用港式美食，霸王鴨、金錢雞有何來頭？穎彤、黃庭鋒實試幾款設備齊全的本地露營車，還可觀星、煮飯仔，適合二人世界。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 荷里活電影被譽為業界殿堂，其歷史可追溯至一百多年前。瀅仴簡介最早期的默片，以及有聲與彩色電影的誕生過程。上世紀約七十年代被指是傳統與新荷里活電影的分水嶺，二者有何不同？來到千禧年，電影走進數碼時代，另一谷主凱婷覺得電腦合成影像(CG)是最大特色。瀅仴引述「派拉蒙法案」案例，它是影響上世紀美國影業發展的重大事件。踏入廿一世紀，串流平台興起，也導致影業的生態再有大轉變。此外，據說電影彩蛋與復活節有關？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 巴打秘景遊粵
programme.desc: 置身遠離繁囂的荔枝窩，「巴打」在生態導師帶領下夜探郊野，上一堂大自然生態課。預定到海岸邊賞日出，陳浚霆卻「唔知醒」，拍檔們決定大整蠱！歎杯金針花茶後，三人初試下田施肥與耘田，有人「泥足深陷」，焦浩軒更把工具弄斷？他們還獲居民設宴招待，品嚐家常客家菜。鴨洲可以找到罕見的褐紅色沉積岩，「鴨頸」、「鴨眼」更是必到打卡點！緊接到訪鄰近小島吉澳，巴打入鄉隨俗，體驗釣魚之餘，也會學做客家茶粿，感受純樸人情味。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: 東南亞食品向來深受香港人歡迎，本集Gigi姐就會教大家做一道充滿東南亞風味的豬頸肉，而帶出這種風味的秘訣在於磨碎了的檸檬葉、魚露、青檸汁和辣椒粉。只要掌握上述竅門，就能很簡單做出美味的豬頸肉。

programme.title: 好市民獎頒獎典禮2025粵
programme.desc: 「好巿民奬」旨在彰顯好人好事，帶動社會守望相助、攜手撲滅罪行。2025年度頒奬典禮於2026年3月14日在會展舉行，並由區永權、陳庭欣擔任司儀，凝聚好市民、好機構的正能量。各個獲獎單位為協助警方破案、拯救生命、推動防罪滅罪作傑出貢獻，TVB直播嘉許情況。單立文、張馳豪、周志康、鄭俊弘、羅毓儀藉歌聲鼓勵一眾無名英雄；男團Hey Brother獻唱之餘，還與林秀怡合演小劇場，宣揚好市民精神與防騙訊息。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，這次兩項訓練都集中於下身，聽從兒童體適能教練的指示來完成吧！跟隨拍子做運動，提起一隻腳上下移動的同時，分別將一隻手以鐘擺形式擺動，以及舉高、放低雙手，可有難度？站立式的「踏單車」動作，有助增強下肢肌力與協調度。輪到「臀部訓練」，以不同姿勢坐於瑜伽墊上，利用臀部發力做鍛練，亦可順道伸展腰部。雙手帶動身體向後仰的動作，既可伸展頸部與胸大肌，練習得多就更易做到拱橋？

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 白色情人節將至，小丸子期盼豐厚回禮，冬田和小渚亦各自對心儀的男孩有所期待。小丸子從花輪口中得知古董的價值，於是偕同爺爺去逛廢物市集，希望發掘到不為人知的寶物，藉此發一筆橫財。

programme.title: 潛行天下粵
programme.desc: 《潛行天下》以全球海洋為主題，採用8K超高清攝影機和水下無人機等技術建構沉浸式觀影體驗，跨越四大洋14國水域拍攝，記錄雙髻鯊、鯨鯊等海洋生物活動，探密三沙永樂龍洞等特殊地形。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 衞生署兒童體能智力測驗中心，大約有七成新症在服務目標的6個月內完成評估，但部分個案聲稱要輪候年半至兩年。輪候時間長，萬一兒童錯過六歲前的「黃金介入期」，對他們成長有多大影響呢？隨著社會對特殊教育需要的認識和接受程度提升，預計懷疑個案會越來越多，政府可以如何加強服務，讓這批小朋友及早獲得評估及適切的治療呢？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 車主打開汽車車頭蓋，卻驚見母鼠與兩隻寶寶，還伴隨膠袋等垃圾。專家講述老鼠生育習性，並建議車主檢查車輛以確保行車安全。某屋苑參加了當局廚餘機資助計劃，但居民於試驗期滿後就繳付維護費用未達共識，決退回機器。事主疑被撞車碰瓷黨敲詐索償，聘請律師卻幫倒忙？事主向律師追問進度竟遭連番迴避，質疑對方的專業性，也擔心未能取回已繳之保證金，涉事律師樓可有回應？側田、張與辰分別於《唱錢》成功「打爆機」，並分享感受。

programme.title: K Cash業主私人貸款呈獻 :香港系列之細間始終你好粵
programme.desc: 祥師兄所說全港最美味的墨魚丸，是怎樣製造的？粉麵店第三代傳人指重點是新鮮，豬肉丸亦是同樣道理！店主偕同母親傳承祖傳的味道，目標成為百年老店！婚禮攝影師銳意打造屬於年輕人的新派旗袍，還提供化妝、攝影一條龍服務。祥師兄穿起店內唐裝，再於街頭拍照，大讚專業！灣仔一間小木屋其實是鬆餅小店，開店源於吃過英國鬆餅，但發覺在港難找到？小店也可發展為大公司，祥師兄走訪本地個人護理用品廠房，CEO亦會細說經營理念。

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻:唱錢粵
programme.desc: 音準、拍子大考驗，唱歌隨時有錢落袋！兩孩之母Mani繼續衝擊第二條提款線，更劍指「魔王之歌」？每年自資到錄音室錄歌的歌唱愛好者亦會接受《唱錢》洗禮，透過挑戰Sing盤上不同歌曲難度「過三關」，甚至是最難的Monster關卡，向掃清九宮格的目標進發。觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: J Music粵
programme.desc: 吳崇銘發覺布志綸作品<如是因 如是果與自己的<掛念你 你好嗎構思相若，於是帶來「一晚限定」的混唱合作，兩人亦分別送上甜蜜情歌<一家之主與<貼地，志綸還有忠粉到場支持偶像。張馳豪新推出<一個人的生日歌，旨在為孤單人士送上力量。獨立歌手Young Hysan唱出他的<道歉啟示。馮熙燮細談獨立組合時期與現時成為簽約歌手的大不同，並感謝T-Rexx將其心路歷程，寫進<聆聽自己的聲音歌詞內。

programme.title: 風味人間 第2季粵
programme.desc: 藍蟹是梭子蟹的分支，美國馬里蘭人愛蒸熟後撒上當地香料，味道鹹香辛辣。日本廚師是拆蟹達人，能將香箱蟹拆肉後再拼回原隻奉客。美國人則喜歡將蟹拆肉，混合麵包糠、蛋黃醬等造蟹餅，酥香可口。螃蟹脫殼後，會暫時變為肉少的水蟹，澳門人看準其特性，煮成水蟹粥，鮮甜滋味。江蘇一帶會將蟛蜞搗碎過濾煮成「豆腐」，軟滑鮮香。將生蟹加鹽醃製的熗蟹，是浙江的地道美食。韓國人亦擅於將生蟹醃製進食，醬油蟹更被喻為「白飯小偷」。

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 四位香港傑出學生運動員獎得主細談感受與目標，又會如何平衡學業與體育？U18男子冰球世錦賽，港隊在尾場挫新西蘭，以四勝一負成績摘亞。曼聯舊將朗尼莊臣來港參與足球活動，與小朋友交流，並回望「紅魔」歲月。甲一籃球總決賽第三場，滿貫與香港東方爭逐領先優勢。王瑋駿、陳鈺文於維港賽艇賽奪雙人雙槳艇金牌；另檢視香港田徑系列賽男、女飛人衝線時刻。這集還帶來學界足球精英賽兩場準決賽戰報、青少年棍網球公開賽記招花絮。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵 及 天氣報告粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 本地出生率持續創新低，但去年嬰幼兒用品零售市場，反而逆市造好，為何會如此？中東局勢緊張，一旦情況進一步惡化，對全球以至香港經濟的影響多大？

programme.title: 叠影狙擊#7粵PG
programme.desc: 諾召開記者會為公司醜聞致歉；晨到總公司履新，接到雄的來電。證物房起火，USB被燒毀，同時證人發亦被殺。KC以曦偽造文件的影片威脅晨助其加入總公司，結果反遭晨威脅。雄約晨見面，讓晨在諾的辦公室裝監聽器。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 車主打開汽車車頭蓋，卻驚見母鼠與兩隻寶寶，還伴隨膠袋等垃圾。專家講述老鼠生育習性，並建議車主檢查車輛以確保行車安全。某屋苑參加了當局廚餘機資助計劃，但居民於試驗期滿後就繳付維護費用未達共識，決退回機器。事主疑被撞車碰瓷黨敲詐索償，聘請律師卻幫倒忙？事主向律師追問進度竟遭連番迴避，質疑對方的專業性，也擔心未能取回已繳之保證金，涉事律師樓可有回應？側田、張與辰分別於《唱錢》成功「打爆機」，並分享感受。

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵
programme.desc: Ben Sir帶隊，聯同祖儀、衍峰向上水古洞村出發，來到村內碩果僅存的舊式茶樓，桌上碌鵝、釀鯪魚等菜餚，品嚐傳統客家風味。三人緊接前往馬草壟迎接醉人日落，捕捉靚人靚景，輕鬆完成打卡之旅！衍峰、鄺潔楹隨蕭欣浩博士尋找舊香港足跡，暢遊上環歌賦街，享用港式美食，霸王鴨、金錢雞有何來頭？穎彤、黃庭鋒實試幾款設備齊全的本地露營車，還可觀星、煮飯仔，適合二人世界。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 荷里活電影被譽為業界殿堂，其歷史可追溯至一百多年前。瀅仴簡介最早期的默片，以及有聲與彩色電影的誕生過程。上世紀約七十年代被指是傳統與新荷里活電影的分水嶺，二者有何不同？來到千禧年，電影走進數碼時代，另一谷主凱婷覺得電腦合成影像(CG)是最大特色。瀅仴引述「派拉蒙法案」案例，它是影響上世紀美國影業發展的重大事件。踏入廿一世紀，串流平台興起，也導致影業的生態再有大轉變。此外，據說電影彩蛋與復活節有關？

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 敏之、凱琳正享用豐富早餐之際，高Ling忽然帶同楊明神秘回歸，為姊妹送上驚喜！走進地道市場，四人兵分兩路，盡情選購特色小食、用品。敏之、凱琳化身「頭巾西施」推銷商品，反應理想！楊明、高Ling緊接接受挑戰，更出動「美男計」兜售頭巾，生意又怎樣？一行人登船前往停泊島，迎接陽光與海灘。當地度假村設有不同類型的酒店房間，三位美女藉小遊戲分房期間卻與製作團隊發生衝突……楊明細看之下，竟察覺當中有蠱惑？

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 香港近年成為全球最長壽地區，幾位十歲出頭的孩子又希望活到多少歲？在節目組和洪永城安排下，小朋友分成兩組，第一組到學校，向校長及負責老師了解校內如何推行生死教育，並共同飼養一條「寵物魚」。第二組前往山野接受求生技巧訓練，掌握搭建帳篷後，一試野外捉魚並隨即動刀劏魚。活動尾聲，兩組人都有一條魚作「食物報酬」，為何一邊感到雀躍，另一邊卻愁雲慘霧？養魚組別當知道眼前蒸魚並非所養的寵物魚，心情和胃口大為轉變！

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 本集將介紹沙特阿拉伯一種獨特的編織工藝- 「阿爾薩度」貝都因人用阿爾薩度親手為家庭製作所需的物品, 她們一邊編織布料, 一邊互相分享家人的消息, 阿爾薩度不只是織布技術, 更是一種團結家庭的集體藝術

programme.title: 翻生工程粵英
programme.desc: 工程師Rob Bell帶大家探討將廢棄結構轉變為未來建築背後的重大挑戰。

programme.title: 隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 壓軸一集，大媽們在社區會堂跳着熟練舞步，對寵物、表演、食物相關歇後語又有多少認識？俗語「豆泥」源自糕點餡料；「蘇蝦仔」正寫是「蘇孲崽」，大學講師廖舜禧逐一解構。三位主持和黃建東在懷舊士多「尋寶」，竟分別互稱表兄妹，究竟搞邊科？「摩羅街雨褸－ 過底」有何喻意？掌故專家鄭寶鴻並講解摩羅街叫摩羅街的原因。主持們走進果欄了解「發財丁」、「坐車」等行內術語；還向毛冷舖店主請教不同毛冷的質地及保存毛衣方法。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 傳統金器手工精巧，現代機器難以取代。主持人來到金舖欣賞各款名貴首飾，期間竟有人被稱呼為「石狗公」，有何所指？花生糖保持古法人手炮製，昔日風味得以保存。麥美恩親自拜師學習做糖，順道細談「石地板種花生」、「發霉花生」等歇後語。「老細」、「事頭」何以成為上司代名詞？且聽中文講師廖舜禧拆解。粵語逾二千年來原來甚少演變，故被視為古漢語「活化石」。廖舜禧追溯廣府話歷史，還從「錫」「勼」「冧」三字解構愛情真義！

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵
programme.desc: 主持與十位藝員在購物城內瘋狂玩樂！「吹杯過杯」只有連詩雅「食白果」，她在問答環節還要玩了半小時才知道「答問題要先舉手」；相反，何君誠的表現令人喜出望外。眾人鬥快「不用手穿褲子」，黃美棋使出瑜伽動作、周志康化身人肉四驅車，怪招盡出。出線比賽坐飛氈賽跑，何雁詩被對手大幅拋離，幸好最後一棒是美棋對連詩雅，賽果可想而知！

programme.title: 熊貓一家人粵普
programme.desc: 各實習飼養員結束了康養區和繁育園的學習和工作，回到神樹坪基地。這段時間，導師們見證了各實習生的成長過程，對他們的進步都感到滿意。另一方面，為了教育園區遊客關於熊貓的基礎知識，實習生們舉辦了教育課堂。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 繪萌、安娜、凜花的演唱會順利結束了，寶石偶像等待著四眼姐姐公佈接下來的順序。但是，表演順序還沒出爐，玫兒就已經站上舞台，還開始進行演唱會。在玫兒促使下，其他寶石偶像也相繼登上舞台。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 鑽石時裝大賽進入最高潮，尚未登台的寶石偶像只剩虹之咲、未來、杏樹三人。寶石時裝大賽開辦者虹之咲，奇蹟閃耀組的中心人物未來，還有星夢頻道偶像頂點的杏樹，鑽石偶像的寶座到底花落誰家!?

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄見家裡經濟財政緊絀，於是走去尋寶，多啦A夢知道後借他「尋寶機」和「飄浮噴霧」。大雄不小心害靜香的胸針掉進水塘，用過法寶「加醋減醋」後心生一計，但在前往水塘的路上遭遇諸多阻撓。

programme.title: B-PROJECT超星團粵日
programme.desc: 在翼的努力之下，Ultras的工作漸上軌道，但A太卻因為一次誤會而抱怨翼把B-PROJECT放在優先，本身對Ultras頗有微詞的剛士因而與A太發生衝突，詎料此時公司卻下令要B-PROJECT發展YourTube，理想做法自然是請教精於此道的Ultras。

programme.title: 魔都女行粵
programme.desc: 發掘「魔都」隱世美食，來到地道麵館，婭溦、糖妹按照網上排名點菜，蛤蜊豬肝拌麵、茄盒、腰花辣肉湯麵，果真名不虛傳。光顧傳聞「怪脾氣」師傅蛋糕店、古早味冰糕與人氣脆香鮮肉月餅，風味小吃滋味連連。主持們被「古董花園」復古氛圍吸引，優雅地淺嚐美式鬆餅與造型蛋糕。接着遊逛老上海歐式風格小區，先打卡再覓食。入黑，味蕾試試新口味，主打越南粉的東南亞餐廳，可會是兩位主持杯茶？酒吧內的雞尾酒名字趣怪，越夜越精彩！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽提到羊肉有滋陰、補腎的功效，是進補的上佳食材。「印度羊肉飯」用上的印度米澱粉含量較低，而且纖維豐富，適合減肥人士。阿媽另將芫荽頭、黑胡椒、魚露等，加入免治羊肉中拌勻，再做成串燒，菜式同樣充滿異國風味。「孜然羊架」需要先煎後焗，但醃製步驟才是重點，有何獨門秘方？三道羊菜式均香濃惹味，肥媽特意準備清甜解膩的「菠蘿椰花糖雪花冰」作甜品。她帶6號到果欄選購菠蘿，泰國、台灣與菲律賓的品種究竟有甚麼分別？

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 6號「單拖」到街市買海鮮，並發揮節目宗旨落力講價！他買來蛋白質豐富的鮑魚，讓肥媽炮製「薑蔥蠔油鮮鮑魚」。鮑魚裙邊呈現黑色，怎樣清潔？「酸菜魚」用上以魚頭與魚骨煮成的魚湯，鮮上加鮮；阿媽還提醒泡椒才是辣味來源，要小心用量。蒸蝦菜式以粉絲和勝瓜置底，能夠吸收蝦的鮮味。製作「涼拌小鮮魷」時，阿6竟拿自己與肥媽的身形教大家分辨魷魚和墨魚，當然惹得阿媽發火！另外，6號又會示範時下火熱飲品奶蓋茶的DIY做法。

programme.title: 少年中醫說粵普
programme.desc: 節目聚焦於青年族群體驗中醫藥文化，集結中國七所中醫藥的7名高校學子，在主持人和中醫藥名家的帶領下，探尋中華醫聖故裡，以「盲盒路線分組體驗」醫聖故裡的形式，了解醫聖對當代中醫藥發展的啟示。

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵PG
programme.desc: 振朗三人跟澳洲名勝三姐妹峰打卡，某人合照時笑言其美貌無死角！路旁駛來紅色跑車，只有兩名幸運兒可自駕遊車河，對講機的另一端則不斷傳來被拋下那一位的「葡萄」話語。眾主持於下午茶時間聊天，話題竟是圍繞內褲「亂噏」！到達豪華住宿地，朱仔躺進浴缸中不願起來。振朗隨後躺在其身上，還哼起歌來，果真有福同享？入夜，大家把酒談心。三人於劇集《反黑路人甲》建立友誼，談及這劇的拍攝點滴，振朗有一幕忍笑失敗仍被播出？

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵PG
programme.desc: 眾主持搭乘空中纜車睇靚景，期間更可登上車頂。振朗出發前曾許願要和慰玲拍MV，來到大型花園，節目組讓他化身「張導」，並爭分奪秒完成拍攝。MV用上「反黑」劇歌<對手戲，請細心觀賞箇中的「三角戀」演出。走進豪華遊艇來趟船屋體驗，主持們邊用餐邊訴說家人對各自演藝路的支持。三好友盛裝到海邊，原來是乘坐水上飛機，振朗更於空中與悉尼歌劇院打卡。在可欣賞海灘勝景的餐廳用膳，大家傾談結婚話題外，朱仔還會「劇透」！

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 吃甜品的口味，與個人形象、性格並無直接關係，甜品達人阿古(古嘉俊) 與嘉賓溫家偉(大隻仔)，雖然外形特質大不相同，卻原來大家同是英式下午茶的「擁躉」。有見及此，阿古特意準備了一款下午茶常見的鬆餅，並以新鮮水果製成大隻仔最愛的藍莓果醬，讓他安坐家中也能享用精美茶點。大隻仔就在製作甜品過程中發掘了不少竅門，足見他的細密心思。完成作品後，大隻仔亦會分享製作心得，以及透露心目中一種與下午茶最匹配的美食。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 天驚訝於太晴三人相識只有兩個月便能百無禁忌，太晴告訴他重點在於互相尊重的心。UNKNOWN出現，太晴三人陷入苦戰，天想通後重新坐上新幹線戰士，更憑著準確的觀察和指示，成功以戰術擊敗敵人。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「My Little Show」的才藝表演舞台再次展開，三位女孩伴隨節拍翩翩起舞，帶來可愛的芭蕾表演，洋溢童真魅力。另一位女生則以古箏彈奏桂林少數民族的舞曲，優雅琴音為現場增添古典氣息。隨着女結他導師彈奏<幼稚園、<告別校園時，她與主持姐姐放聲合唱，勾起許多美好的校園回憶，瀅仴姐姐尤其難忘有同學仔不小心在課堂上放屁的趣事。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 箭豬荒山在山上挖掘尋寶但一無所穫，後來遇到攤檔的蚯蚓媽媽，聽信其占卜並帶她上山。汪汪警察局接報蚯蚓媽媽被綁架，屁屁偵探亦獲邀加入調查，一行人根據種種線索，上山追查蚯蚓媽媽下落。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子家裡電視機故障，需要三天時間才能修好，小丸子自不用說，連姐姐也罕有地表示不滿。小玉正在看一本小說，並和冬田約好看完後互相分享感想，但過程中一直有事令她分心，導致閱讀進度緩慢。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 潛行天下粵
programme.desc: 《潛行天下》以全球海洋為主題，採用8K超高清攝影機和水下無人機等技術建構沉浸式觀影體驗，跨越四大洋14國水域拍攝，記錄雙髻鯊、鯨鯊等海洋生物活動，探密三沙永樂龍洞等特殊地形。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 戲棚在香港已有大約150年歷史，過往每逢神誕、太平清醮、盂蘭勝會，一座座臨時戲棚便會以竹、木搭建而成，棚內或做拜神儀式，或做「神功戲」表演。不過隨著城市發展及經濟轉型，不少拜神儀式已經簡化，部分社區在盂蘭勝會期間，更會轉用金屬取締竹木搭建的戲棚。面對行業式微，一群戲棚師傅如何延續傳統的竹棚技藝？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 香港歐化飛鷹活絡油呈獻:中年好聲音4粵
programme.desc: 導師分組賽迎來最終回，台上再次舉行獨唱較量，三隊代表分別演繹那英、張學友、張惠妹的作品。這集最低分隊伍要淘汰一人之外，本輪三集累積總分最低隊伍亦會有兩人被淘汰，競爭越趨白熱化！紅隊布志綸、紫隊高少華、綠隊張嘉銘，三位導師各自帶領的學員當中，誰人即將離開《中4》舞台？此外，這集亦會誕生本輯節目的首位MVP。

programme.title: 一周星星粵
programme.desc: 黎耀祥、蕭正楠、曹永廉因參演《大太監》而熟絡，早前拍綜藝自駕遊澳洲，有何深刻點滴？除了啜核挖苦的日常外，他們亦會有浪漫一面！「你問我答」，黎諾懿向祥哥索「拎視帝」秘訣，祥哥亦妙趣示範相同對白的三種演繹。阿蕭又可「恨得獎」？阿廉的腰圍受黃智賢關注，主持潘盈慧拿出量尺……某人錄音控訴阿蕭常與阿廉通電話，又不時穿著對方衣服，莫非有不可告人之事？三位好丈夫又會如何回答「我今日有何不同」這條經典的女伴提問？

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 星廚莫燦霖推介居酒屋，與波波享用炒墨魚配木魚醬油汁、高森和牛三文治配牛骨湯，令人回味無窮。北角地膽施焯日走訪該區的食街，試吃吞拿魚蘋果碎蛋比高包、不同餡料的煎餃，以及台式麻醬涼麵配滷水百頁豆腐。Agnes再帶焯日品嚐新派韓式風味亞洲料理，包括配上水果特製醬汁的魷魚刺身、咖喱韓式炸雞，以及紹酒醉醬油蟹，盡是不一樣的味道。九龍城開業逾七十年的清真菜館，其爆汁牛肉餅、羊肉小籠包與咖喱羊腩，皆為必試名物。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 叠影狙擊#8粵PG
programme.desc: 曉晨潛入文諾的辦公室放下竊聽器，怎料被監控鏡頭拍下來了，於是將錯就錯，假裝投靠文諾，並藉著人工島的計劃書，取得俊雄的信任。恆輝無故失蹤，天齊懷疑院長謀財害命，於是潛入院長室，竟然發現大量老人的身份證…

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 少年中醫說粵普
programme.desc: 節目聚焦於青年族群體驗中醫藥文化，集結中國七所中醫藥的7名高校學子，在主持人和中醫藥名家的帶領下，探尋中華醫聖故裡，以「盲盒路線分組體驗」醫聖故裡的形式，了解醫聖對當代中醫藥發展的啟示。

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵PG
programme.desc: 四人到清邁郊外等待看日出，並訴說相關經歷。和嘉洛同往看日出許願竟是兩男？JW最有記憶的日出，是與吳業坤一起拍劇。畏高的JW鼓起勇氣試玩動力滑翔傘，降落即要求擁抱互勉。登艇遊河兼食船麵，甚麼令陳瀅眼濕濕？走進市場，大家開始試吃之行，JW獻出食榴槤第一次。主持們換上民族服，邊品嚐地道美食邊欣賞民族表演。四人分組在周末市集買食物開餐，同時考驗另類默契。挑戰叢林間的過山車與飛索，JW能否再次戰勝恐懼？

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵PG
programme.desc: 深入清邁鄉村逛小店，朱仔竟踴躍發言，拍檔都配合地轉為「靜音模式」。朱仔更挑戰JW底線要其吃蜜蜂蛋，嚇得她落荒而逃！四人分享清邁之旅難忘點滴，有人講到喊，更發覺此行絕對不容嘉洛缺席！大家還透過收到的禮物，競猜自己的「秘密天使」……張振朗、賴慰玲接力出發，辦理飛澳洲的登機手續之際，朱仔驚喜送機，卻是「計中計」，他會乘坐航班的商務位同行。站在海水中央食蠔，可有特別感受？不過，振朗的熟練開蠔技術才是焦點！

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 吃甜品的口味，與個人形象、性格並無直接關係，甜品達人阿古(古嘉俊) 與嘉賓溫家偉(大隻仔)，雖然外形特質大不相同，卻原來大家同是英式下午茶的「擁躉」。有見及此，阿古特意準備了一款下午茶常見的鬆餅，並以新鮮水果製成大隻仔最愛的藍莓果醬，讓他安坐家中也能享用精美茶點。大隻仔就在製作甜品過程中發掘了不少竅門，足見他的細密心思。完成作品後，大隻仔亦會分享製作心得，以及透露心目中一種與下午茶最匹配的美食。

programme.title: 魔都女行粵
programme.desc: 糖妹、婭溦變身優雅吃貨，置身以老香港美學打造的點心餐廳，品嚐燉老鴿湯、波龍蘆筍餃、Q彈太雕蛋蒸黃魚，黑米鹹水角又有甚麼驚喜滋味？兩位可人兒轉往別緻Cafe，一件拿破崙草莓蛋糕，她們竟掀起吉士醬與奶油之爭！分途發掘魔都小店，糖妹踏足潮人必到的中古風生活雜貨，搜羅各式可愛造型的創意家品。另一邊廂，婭溦在澳洲網紅旗艦店朝聖，「悉瓜」蛋糕一試難忘。放慢腳步，二人偷得浮生光顧酒館，糖妹還會挑戰辣辣上海川菜！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽提到羊肉有滋陰、補腎的功效，是進補的上佳食材。「印度羊肉飯」用上的印度米澱粉含量較低，而且纖維豐富，適合減肥人士。阿媽另將芫荽頭、黑胡椒、魚露等，加入免治羊肉中拌勻，再做成串燒，菜式同樣充滿異國風味。「孜然羊架」需要先煎後焗，但醃製步驟才是重點，有何獨門秘方？三道羊菜式均香濃惹味，肥媽特意準備清甜解膩的「菠蘿椰花糖雪花冰」作甜品。她帶6號到果欄選購菠蘿，泰國、台灣與菲律賓的品種究竟有甚麼分別？

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 6號「單拖」到街市買海鮮，並發揮節目宗旨落力講價！他買來蛋白質豐富的鮑魚，讓肥媽炮製「薑蔥蠔油鮮鮑魚」。鮑魚裙邊呈現黑色，怎樣清潔？「酸菜魚」用上以魚頭與魚骨煮成的魚湯，鮮上加鮮；阿媽還提醒泡椒才是辣味來源，要小心用量。蒸蝦菜式以粉絲和勝瓜置底，能夠吸收蝦的鮮味。製作「涼拌小鮮魷」時，阿6竟拿自己與肥媽的身形教大家分辨魷魚和墨魚，當然惹得阿媽發火！另外，6號又會示範時下火熱飲品奶蓋茶的DIY做法。

programme.title: 熊貓一家人粵普
programme.desc: 各實習飼養員結束了康養區和繁育園的學習和工作，回到神樹坪基地。這段時間，導師們見證了各實習生的成長過程，對他們的進步都感到滿意。另一方面，為了教育園區遊客關於熊貓的基礎知識，實習生們舉辦了教育課堂。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#54粵
programme.desc: 慶智擒小偷，被頒良好市民獎外，就連電視台也來採訪。喜發現藥房近日常無故失竊，就連義的名牌衫褲也忽然被偷，最終揭發犯人竟是「捉賊英雄」慶。原來高慶是因為要替社區中心籌款購買乒乓桌，才甘願作賊。

programme.title: 天龍八部#27粵普PG
programme.desc: 虛竹因破了四戒，少林高僧決定將他逐出師門，並處以杖刑，此時傳來各大武林人士前來拜訪的消息，段譽、丁春秋、阿紫、慕容復同時在場。丁春秋以阿紫要脅莊聚賢，蕭峯突然現身，段譽、虛竹與蕭峯兄弟聚頭，惺惺相惜。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 貝殼類海鮮五花八門，跟鼎爺到街市長知識。鼎爺先製作「元貝蒸豆腐」，在元貝上?十字花有何作用？鼎爺再以鮮炸豬油爆香料頭、酒釀、雞件，加上生抽、紅棗等兜炒成惹味「三杯雞」，還道出菜式的故事。鼎爺與阿譚到南海，品嚐新鮮霸王花、霸王花乾菜式。為何霸王花乾要先蒸後曬？鼎爺再送上時令補身佳餚，以鹿茸大補酒、陳皮、玉竹等製作「酒燉排骨」。鼎爺再以櫻花蝦，加上鮮蝦薄片、大豆芽炮製炒飯，香脆口感從哪裏來？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 口腔衛生差是舌癌成因之一，如口腔潰瘍逾兩週仍未癒合就要提高警覺。臨床腫瘤科醫生指出，蛀牙也會增加患舌癌風險，還有甚麼口腔問題要留意？此外，醫生亦細說舌癌的防治資訊。資深歌手張德蘭即將開騷，她曾多次踏上紅館舞台，卻是首次在那裡舉行個唱？她透露可圓夢除了有賴好友葉振棠牽線，也因製作人的盛情難卻。德蘭姐姐更緊貼時代開設社交帳號，對能跟各地歌迷拉近距離感開心。「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「南瓜汁椰菜花蝦球」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在東莞粵
programme.desc: 東莞方言「去歸」，就是回家的意思。主持王祖藍這集就帶觀眾「去歸」，來到他的老家厚街，先品嚐一頓菜餚豐富的「自給自足」東莞家宴。在厚街一定要享用的，還有馳名的臘味和燒味美食，一間廿四小時營業的燒味店，出品到底有多好吃？及至晚上，祖藍於「黃金小鎮」遊逛、「掃街」，這個夜市究竟有些甚麼吸引着厚街的打工人？

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#6粵
programme.desc: 德正偷偷帶美娜參觀豆品廠卻被秀瓊發現，眾人到廠房開戰……秀瓊得知司徒嵐是兆明女友，反對二人交往。兆明向竇彰說出他和司徒嵐相識經過；司徒嵐帶兆明見秀瓊，秀瓊稱他沒法給司徒嵐幸福。兆明進行第二階段計劃，有意與超市合作，但竇彰反對；竇彰說出心中怨氣，更將計劃書撕毀。秀瓊設計由文員蕭文芳向兆明挑逗，但美人計失敗；秀瓊拿出支票任他填寫，條件是要他離開司徒嵐……兆明奇怪兆賢何以在鼎福和出現，兆賢坦言已退學……

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: 萬在演唱會上為救千，被照明擊中受傷。消息指萬因臉部受傷而失蹤，百上門力勸千勿放棄唱歌，並提出以五年為期，與他拍檔去闖出名堂。了聽百說完後依然不為所動，百無奈離開，並在樓下遇到千。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 早於十九至二十世紀，香港的礦業十分興盛，而位於北區近沙頭角的蓮麻坑礦洞，近期更重新開放讓市民參觀。這集「Kids’ Notes」，兩位嘉賓帶同幾款礦石，推介礦洞必到「打卡位」，並提醒參觀時的注意事項。香港曾經有近百個大大小小的石礦場，大致上都以花崗岩為主，原來美利樓、終審法院大樓都是用上本地石礦場出產的花崗岩建成！鯉魚門以海鮮聞名，原來之前也是一個大型石礦場？且聽嘉賓細說更多相關歷史資訊。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 媽媽要求大雄整理房間，多啦A夢借他「整理陳列室」，助他篩選出沒用雜物，好丟掉騰出空間。大雄嫌上學路沉悶，多啦A夢用「交換地圖」為他製造新奇路線，其後更以此設計賽道，舉行一場大賽車。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 樓市升勢持續，鰂魚涌一個大型屋苑，成交也有所加快，樓價有否跟隨向上？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2764粵
programme.desc: Ceci與敢威合作發展某項工程，到期需繳付工程費，卻以卜卜脆病倒入院為由，拒絕商談此事。眼看Ceci極看重卜卜脆，視她如同姊妹，力蓮有意取代她，並設法與Ceci結義金蘭，陰差陽錯下卻令Ceci決意順應「天機」，認定瑞素為義妹。出於某些原因，瑞素暫住Ceci的別墅，意外發現其秘密。另一方面，瑞素欲討好敢威，敢威卻不屑一顧，毫不領情。Ceci相約敢威、雷公等人會面，宣佈與瑞素有關之事，眾人震驚不已……

programme.title: X Wallet呈獻:臥底嬌娃#16粵PG
programme.desc: 兩年前，剛潛入二世的奕風壓力巨大。洗衣店的一次機器故障，奕風情緒爆發，卻因電話投訴認識一位女客服。對方甜美的聲音，循循善誘的態度，溫柔體貼的舉動，讓奕風得到治癒。奕風屢次藉口致電對方尋求慰藉，某天客服竟換了人！奕風替世豪收數，對象恰巧是這客服的鄰居。二人終相認，但奕風同時讓對方目睹其暴力扭曲的一面；幸好於奕風的嫲嫲加持下，兩人關係親近不少。一切似是向好發展之際，嫲嫲的去世卻為奕風帶來沉重打擊……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#8粵普PG
programme.desc: 皇帝下令嚴懲趙森垚，南趙王承認推動法師之死。楚楚與冷月訪慈光寺，得知法師曾收養一子淨緣，生母沁香坦承曾謊稱淨緣為法師之子，另揭露有人以香粉操控教坊司女子勾引客人。瑾瑜憂心南趙幕後主使，皇帝命其暗查。

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：他們的澳洲駕期粵
programme.desc: 登機準備向墨爾本出發，黎耀祥、蕭正楠舉杯祝願旅途順利，曹永廉卻不獲「歡迎」？自駕遊第一站行逛市集與購物拱廊，品嚐地道美食，訴說「兄弟情」。置身歷史悠久的美術館，三子藉參觀展覽、繪畫體驗，滋養藝術氣息。往布勒山路途遙遠，「司機」阿廉卻連啟動汽車都出事，老友們如何安心充電？坐吊車登雪山，三位大細路心急互擲雪球，快問快答遊戲更變集火爆料時間！三人隨訓練員同乘一車，享受雪橇犬拉車的爽快感，卻差點衝出懸崖？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#24粵
programme.desc: 趙倩與娘蓉不約而同看中一幅紅衣料，娘蓉氣荊俊口不擇言，將所有紅衣料買光。娘蓉向不韋打聽少龍是何人後，帶著紅衣料訪趙倩，說要替她設計嫁衣，更羨慕趙倩為追求所愛拋開一切。朱姬遂舉薦嫪毐出任廷尉，嬴政即推薦少龍，不韋附和。不韋看出嫪毐野心，提醒他安分。趙倩發現殺少龍密令，嫪毐面露殺機。少龍等押趙穆入咸陽，嬴政想起雅遭趙穆蹂躪致死，將匕首直刺趙穆心臟。少龍看見趙倩死不瞑目躺在江邊，悲痛欲絕，持劍直闖呂府。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#54粵
programme.desc: 慶智擒小偷，被頒良好市民獎外，就連電視台也來採訪。喜發現藥房近日常無故失竊，就連義的名牌衫褲也忽然被偷，最終揭發犯人竟是「捉賊英雄」慶。原來高慶是因為要替社區中心籌款購買乒乓桌，才甘願作賊。

programme.title: 天龍八部#27粵普PG
programme.desc: 虛竹因破了四戒，少林高僧決定將他逐出師門，並處以杖刑，此時傳來各大武林人士前來拜訪的消息，段譽、丁春秋、阿紫、慕容復同時在場。丁春秋以阿紫要脅莊聚賢，蕭峯突然現身，段譽、虛竹與蕭峯兄弟聚頭，惺惺相惜。

programme.title: 紳士與小姐
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【離家追夢，還是回家團圓？馮家菜北漂生存戰】馮家菜是北京頗具名氣的淮揚菜館，女強人大米憑藉一身拼勁，將小館打造成金字招牌，卻因妹夫欠債，陷入食品安全風波，生意一落千丈。為救餐館，她請出退休父親參賽，奪得全國冠軍，卻招來資本大鱷周路的覬覦。親情與利益交織，事業與愛情碰撞，兄妹間信任破裂，馮家菜面臨生死存亡。當大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子終於悔悟，全家攜手重建家業。當揚州炒飯再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改變。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金馬演員攜手演出破產母女生存記】少見的審計職場劇，樂觀正向，帶給人心激勵。從小在拮据家庭成長的邱冬娜，在課業工作上總是特別勤奮，希望透過自己的努力讓母親過上好生活。畢業後，因緣際會下進入了前輩顧飛開的審計稽核公司，面對孤僻但能力強的主管顧飛，邱冬娜雖然頭痛但絕不認輸！運用從母親身上學到的智慧，還有艱困生活帶給她的精打細算體質，邱冬娜總能屢出奇招化解艱難任務。曾有心理創傷的主管顧飛，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，兩人亦師亦友,相互扶持鼓勵，逐漸治癒傷口，成為彼此的靈魂伴侶。

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 我的野蠻王妃
programme.desc: 【神級經典韓劇，尹恩惠、朱智勳、金楨勳、宋智孝再現現代宮廷指腹為婚！！】申采靜原本只是一名平凡無奇的高中學生，得知爺爺的遺囑中，她與皇太子李信有婚約在身。因家中債務的原因，在無可奈何的情況完婚。待在皇室的申采靜對宮內生活十分反彈，此時海歸回來的皇位第二繼承者李律及李信前女友閔孝琳的存在，展開錯綜複雜的故事。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 壞記憶橡皮擦(完)
programme.desc: 【金在中攜陳世娫出演新劇《壞記憶橡皮擦》回歸電視劇！！】曾是被看好的網球之星李君，在負傷之後喪失了自尊心，認為自己從人生的主角變成配角。遇上腦研究中心的醫生景珠妍，使用了記憶橡皮擦抹去了過去記憶，重生為運動經紀人，而景珠妍也意外成了他的初戀。因被篡改的記憶開始的羅曼史，在得知真相后其結局將會如何呢？

programme.title: 六龍飛天
programme.desc: 李成桂為了正式的投身政治啓程去往開京，李芳遠也跟隨着父親去了開京。來到開京的李芳遠看到了置百姓死活於不顧只為自己填飽肚子的權文勢族，無法抑制住自己內心的憤怒。原本就對於李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁謙將李成桂邀請到自己家裏並舉辦了宴會，在宴會上李仁謙給他看了以他背叛了曾經像兄弟一樣的趙小生為題材的街頭劇。在宴會結束後李成桂為了讓李仁謙保守自己背叛趙末生的秘密，向李仁謙低下了頭，李芳遠目擊到了這一幕。

programme.title: 珠玉在側(完)
programme.desc: 【不務正業公子雯珺陰錯陽差納ㄚ環玉薦師徐璐！！】個性古靈精怪的單單單，一心想成為薦玉師卻苦無機會，只能幫姐姐單雙雙賣些假玉，一次交易過程中無意得罪了富家玩絝公子裴沛，彼此留下很差的印象。又因突發危機單單單走投無路入府成為ㄚ環，府邸主人意外是裴沛，單單單也在調笑皆非中與裴沛逐漸相知相惜。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 豬豬俠之超星五靈俠S3
programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的岩漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的岩漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.title: 檢索愛情
programme.desc: 【林秀晶X張基龍大談姐弟戀年下男狂撩職場女強人】聚焦於三位35歲女性——裴朵美、車賢和宋佳景，她們在職場和感情中勇敢追夢。這三位獨立的女性，專注於自己的事業，成為職場上的佼佼者。然而在她們堅強的外表下，深藏著對愛情的渴望。儘管在追求夢想的道路上充滿坎坷，她們依然堅信自己的抉擇。在她們身後都有一位，用自己的方式默默守護的真命天子，以現實的筆觸描繪了這三個女性在職場上的競爭和情感中的糾結，將粉紅泡泡與現實的辛酸完美結合。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高銀與朴海鎮領銜，知名主角群展現校園青春浪漫！！】大學新生洪雪面對完美又腹黑的劉正學長，因獨特魅力逐漸受他吸引。隨著兩人情意漸濃，劉正的神秘性個性和控制慾逐漸浮出水面，兩人微妙的心理戰，以及性格不羈同學的白仁浩再洪雪身邊守候，三人的矛盾、最終洪雪情歸何處?

programme.title: 韓國小姐(完)
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李聖旻社區大叔們聯手打造韓國小姐】高中時自恃美貌過人，而沒有好好唸書的吳智英，畢業後憑藉外表當上百貨的電梯小姐，看似光鮮亮麗的工作，背後隱藏著許多辛酸，面對毛手毛腳的變態上司，以及百貨種種不合理的工作規定，年紀增長且缺乏競爭力另吳智英後悔莫及，偶然的機會下，與現職化妝品公司社長的前男友相遇，公司即將倒閉的金亨俊，與債主鄭先生一同把平凡女孩打造為頂級韓國小姐的勵志故事。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 檢索愛情
programme.desc: 【林秀晶X張基龍大談姐弟戀年下男狂撩職場女強人】聚焦於三位35歲女性——裴朵美、車賢和宋佳景，她們在職場和感情中勇敢追夢。這三位獨立的女性，專注於自己的事業，成為職場上的佼佼者。然而在她們堅強的外表下，深藏著對愛情的渴望。儘管在追求夢想的道路上充滿坎坷，她們依然堅信自己的抉擇。在她們身後都有一位，用自己的方式默默守護的真命天子，以現實的筆觸描繪了這三個女性在職場上的競爭和情感中的糾結，將粉紅泡泡與現實的辛酸完美結合。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龍！都會家庭的高考大作戰】以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張。另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難。最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想。這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭、親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻。

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The castle of Robins
programme.desc: Since the lens fails to be recovered, Dr. No wants to make another, but he needs robins to make it. So he attacks Rubidia, a region filled with different precious stones. But Oxin the king of Rubidia makes Dr. No his prisoner. And locked him in the castle where Chip is also locked, as Oxin also makes them prisoners to make them work as slaves in his mines. Dr. No try to make Chip to give him back the lens, but Chip denies. Later, the two manage to escape from the castle and Dr. No chases Chip with his craft. But the boy gets the scientist falls into a trap and also helps free the slaves of Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The harmonica trap
programme.desc: Chip and his friends create a zone with formations resembling musical instruments and make sounds harmonious. Suddenly, they become trapped within a rectangle of quartz crystals that vibrate when they form a sonic trap. A musician atom who has caught them, seeks members to assemble an orchestra. The antimatters are near and Chip asked the musician to prepare the trap to retain them and escape. The musician agrees and the antimatters are prisoners of the musician that makes them hear the terrible sound of his compositions.

He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE

After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.desc: Xuli and Glitch go head to head as they try to beat the Go Jet Academy land speed record.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Comet's Coming
programme.desc: Sarah &amp; Duck are excited to visit the observatory to see a passing comet.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Perfect
programme.desc: For her Father's Day card, Bluey sets out to draw a picture of herself and her father together. Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Explorers

programme.desc: Morris and Pearl have lost one of their medals in the canal. Stanley fishes it out only have the complete collection dropped in. Stanley dons a diver's suit and goes after them.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Pumpkin
programme.desc: Stanley must keep Myrtle's pumpkin safe from Speedy the snail. He builds a series of obstacles and defences to protect it from the tenacious Speedy who tests Stanley's ingenuity.

programme.title: Number 1 Newton Avenue (S1) - Mysterious Marks
programme.desc: A series exploring maths in everyday scenarios. With catchy songs and fun animation.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time to go Litter Picking
programme.desc: JoJo has lots of questions about the bin lorries that keep Gran Gran's street tidy. And it's time for JoJo to keep the community garden tidy on a litter pick with the Nature Club.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Explorers
programme.desc: While waiting to be picked up from school, Jack plays at being a sailor trying to find his way back home to Australia. Meanwhile, Jack's Dad has got lost on route to collect him.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Phones
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to... he's going to need an app to order the food!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Pavlova
programme.desc: Mum won't let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Café in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Collecting Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is cleaning his biscuit tin collection, one of the many things he collects. The squirrels are inspired to make their own collections.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Yoga Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels have arrived and they're all a little bit hyped up with bundles of energy. Things are starting to get a bit frantic, and Duggee needs to calm them all down. Fortunately, he has his Yoga Badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Calm Down
programme.desc: Water, water, everywhere - there's a flood in our hospital soap opera! Grown-up Tag the firefighter splashes around. It's a good job grown-up Happy the lifeguard is on hand

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Go Jet Academy: Mudslide
programme.desc: It's a very rainy day at the Go Jet Academy and the Go Jetters are teaching the Cadets some crucial Go Jetter skills.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Plum
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp; Fruits theatre, it's Plum performing the Sugar Plum Fairy Bounce and attempting to do not one, not two, but three pirouettes in midair!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Corn
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp; Fruits theatre, it's Corn singing an A-maiz-ing Counting Song about his remarkably organised kernel rows.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Hiccup Havoc
programme.desc: Supertato gets hiccups while Evil Pea is firing jam at Tato Tower. Supertato harnesses the power of his hiccups to save Tato Tower from Evil Pea's jam attack.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Dino Danger
programme.desc: A toy dinosaur rampages in the Supermarket and scares the Grape Kids. Carrot and Supertato work out that it's controlled by a remote control and get the dinosaur back in its box.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Trailer
programme.desc: When it's time for the Tubby Custard Ride, there's a special trailer the Teletubbies haven't seen before. It's for The Noo-Noo who gets to go on a special Tubby Custard Ride.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Ding fought against many swordsmen and won, so he took his first defeat badly and wanted to commit suicide. It is then that he meets the granddaughter of a mystic Sect leader and falls in love. When they want to get married, the Sect leader presents Ding with the "Full Moon Scimitar", on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fete. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: This is Jenny Hu's stunning debut as a struggling singer who tries to keep her career and marriage intact. This movie also includes seven memorable hit songs.

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mother's death - a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out...

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out...

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Huan Zhu's ghost seeks help from "Fake Ghost Catchers" Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitor's ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhu's sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become "The Five Shaolin Masters".

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score "The Proud One". Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: This is a martial arts epic directed by Chang Cheh. In the Sung Dynasty, the government is run by corrupt officials, so Sung Jiang gathers 108 outlaws at Mount Liang and establishes a band of patriotic heroes to end the repression of brutal overlords.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s "a-go-go" era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: The Villains
programme.desc: Hung is an orphan seeking help from her wealthy uncle who has two sons but only dotes on the younger son Feng, a playboy. Feng covets the beauty of Hung and rapes her but when she gets pregnant, Hung is wrongfully accused and gets sent off by her uncle to protect Feng. Will Feng be punished for his villainy?

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lou's brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner. When his best friend, Bobby begins investigating recent murder cases committed by Kam, he discovers that the mastermind behind these cases is actually his superintendent.

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies' youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond...

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm's VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident...

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation...

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Zombie Island
programme.desc: Jeff, a big fan of zombies, goes to a deserted and mysterious island with his friends hoping to seek out exciting adventures. What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder happens, and the suspects get killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy over two generations.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law's affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered and cremated. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother's death?

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter -the sole witness- mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn...

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other's true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle...

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then...

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.
